item.title: AttoChess, a complete, playable chess program for 16-bit x86 DOS in 278 bytes
item.description:
📝 01 · Display The board draws itself: no render buffer, no int 21h/09h This accounts for the largest saving. That path costs a buffer pointer setup, the copy loop's store, the terminator write, and, because the buffer lives after the board, a reserved board array in the image. The display loop streams each byte straight to the console with int 29h (DOS fast console output): borders become newlines, empty squares become NULs, and only real pieces take the ASCII transform.
🔗 Read more: https://nicholas-afk.github.io/AttoChess/
